item.title: Microsoft Internship
item.description:
How I landed my Microsoft Internship

Starting my internship

On July 17th, 2019, I started my Microsoft internship. We registered for I9 employment, and sat through a bunch of presentations Truthfully, they were terribily boring to me, but it’s nice to see that the Microsoft recruiters truly believe in Microsoft’s mission: Empower every person and organization on this planet to achieve more.

Camp Microsoft

Microsoft has started an intern program called Camp Microsoft, which is a collection of intern activities and events that help interns get to know one another and pass the time. You are put in a random group of other interns, led by two Microsoft employees.
